Retail BI · 2015–2018 · 9,993 order lines

Superstore Margin Console

An interactive profitability audit of a US retailer. Search or filter by product, category, region, segment, shipping mode, discount, or year — every chart and the table below recompute live from the underlying order lines.

Finding: every discount band above 20% is margin-negative in every category. Nearly 1 in 5 order lines (18.7%) lose money — concentrated in Furniture (Tables, Bookcases) and deep-discounted Office Supplies (binders).
